entities.name: PMID:31361973
observations: In VDRΔIEC mice and intestinal organoids, epithelial VDR deficiency decreased ATG16L1 and Beclin-1, increased apoptosis, and was described as impaired autophagy; the study examined small intestine and colon epithelium.

entities.name: PMID:33217447
observations: Paneth-cell-specific VDR knockout caused reduced autophagic responses and increased inflammation after Salmonella infection; this is a cell-subtype-specific model rather than whole intestinal epithelial deletion.

entities.name: VDR
observations: Intestinal epithelial VDR supports expression of autophagy-related proteins including ATG16L1 and Beclin-1 in mouse intestine and organoids.

entities.name: ATG16L1
observations: ATG16L1 expression was reduced in intestinal epithelium from VDRΔIEC mice; related VDR studies connect ATG16L1 to autophagic responses.

entities.name: Beclin-1
observations: Beclin-1 was decreased in intestinal epithelium and organoids lacking VDR; increased Bax-associated apoptosis was proposed to reduce autophagy through Beclin-1.
